correctness.rationale: Fibonacci congruence identities give a one-cycle clockwise neighbor map with positive edge lengths totaling exactly one for both parities. The translated second window is subdivided into five explicit classes with complete index exhaustion. Each Sturmian pair-word cylinder is one connected refined arc because single-block arcs are shorter than one half. This proves exact frequencies and, via Binet limits, the information constant. Exact Q(sqrt(5)) verification at 9 finite orders independently checks the histograms, and 6 orders check joint-word uniqueness; limits rest on proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: A natural two-window long-range statistic of the uniquely ergodic golden Sturmian dynamical system is exactly classified. Unlike the three-distance and 3d-distance results, the full multiset of nonconsecutive-circle gaps and complete joint-word probabilities are computed. Their nontrivial centered mutual-information constant quantifies persistent phase information at proportional time separation, filling a motivated gap beyond entropy rate or single-block statistics.
